title: Small-scale upper bound for Hⁿ(M ∩ η_{x,r}⁻¹(U)) from a test function dominating 1_U at an approximate tangent point
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), x ∈ ℝ^P, and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P which is the approximate tangent space of M at x (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q). Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be a measurable set and f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ) with f ≥ 0 everywhere and f ≥ 1 on U. If t ∈ [0, ∞] satisfies ofReal(∫_Q f dHⁿ) < t, then for all sufficiently small r > 0 (eventually in 𝓝[>] 0), Hⁿ(M ∩ η_{x,r}⁻¹(U)) ≤ t·rⁿ, where η_{x,r}(z) = r⁻¹(z − x) is SimonGMT's blowUpMap x r.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ), μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → MeasurableSet U → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → (∀ y ∈ U, 1 ≤ f y) → ∀ t : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n]) < t → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μHE[n] (M ∩ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r ⁻¹' U) ≤ t * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)
